market_summary: Intraday Nov 18 (not the final close): S&P 500 -0.2% near 7,327, Dow -0.9% near 50,306, Nasdaq +0.3%, Russell 2000 +1.1%. The 10-year yield sat near 5.06%, down slightly after closing about 5.10% on Nov 17, with traders pricing a December Fed hike; October FOMC minutes were due at 2pm ET and the Fed held at 3.75-4.00% in October with two members favouring a hike. Nvidia turned lower despite record revenue as uncertainty over its leadership after Jensen Huang's exit weighed. WTI crude fell about 2% to near $83 after a larger-than-expected US stock build. Xi called for removing trade barriers ahead of meeting Trump and Putin in China.

AMZN.reason: Up about 3% midday Nov 18 after Nvidia beat; AWS demand intact, rebound from Nov 16 selloff.

AXOS.reason: Up under 1% midday; steady bank at under 9x forward earnings, no news.

BABA.reason: Down about 1% into Nov 19 pre-open results; US remote-compute curbs on Chinese firms are the overhang.

ENPH.reason: Down about 4% midday; continues to lag, no catalyst.

FIGR.reason: Up about 4% midday on broad fintech bounce; no company news.

GOOGL.reason: Flat to up 0.3% midday after 4% drop Nov 16; TPU and cloud story unchanged.

LDI.reason: Up about 10% midday but still a sub-dollar penny stock; speculative, size small.

META.reason: Down 0.5% midday; capex-heavy spender barely moved on Nvidia beat.

MRVL.reason: Gave up 4% premarket gain, down about 3% midday; Lumentum deal dilution worries persist.

MU.reason: Up 3.5% pre-open then down about 2% midday as Nvidia reversed; memory pricing still strong.

NFLX.reason: Up about 1% midday; no news, stays out of AI chip volatility.

NVDA.reason: Beat and raised (Q4 guide $130B) yet down about 2-3% Nov 18; board won't reinstate Huang, China excluded from guide.

RKT.reason: Up about 3% midday with mortgage names; no company news.

TSM.reason: Up 4% premarket but flat by midday as Nvidia faded; demand outlook from $130B guide supportive.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender reported; mark unchanged at 2.27x Nov 2024.

OPENAI.reason: No new round or tender reported this session; mark unchanged at 7.96x. Anthropic IPO is the new comp.

headlines: Nvidia beat with Q4 guide of $130B, then fell about 2-3% Nov 18; board rules out Huang return.
Chip rally faded: MU and MRVL down 2-3% midday after premarket gains; TSM flat.
Anthropic prices IPO tonight at $70-78 range; ANT trades Thu US time (Fri morning AEDT).
Alibaba reports Thu before US open (Thu 11pm AEDT) under new US compute curbs.
10-yr yield near 5.06%; traders pricing a December Fed hike.
